route_creation_rule: The route label never creates authority. A route decision is only ever recorded on an envelope that already carries exact producer refs, producer-native state and reason. No learned rule, model or comparability authority is created anywhere in this module.

cases.why_direct_is_legitimate: The exact direct empirical producer contract is already sufficient for the analytical/consumer path; the accepted C1-02 composition consumes it without any learned or adjudicating wrapper.
cases.authority_demanded: none beyond the producer's own exact source/release/risk/measure authority

cases.why_learned_is_genuinely_required: A structural-mediation use of an empirical fact requires a named, hash-bound StructuralAdmissionRule plus matching STRUCTURAL_ADMISSION authority. Without the rule the owner cannot return ADMITTED, which is exactly the learned/adjudicated-required situation on this base.
cases.evidence: With rule=None the owner returns a non-ADMITTED decision for a SUPPORTED fact; the same fact is nonetheless lawfully consumable on the direct route. So the requirement is use-specific, not universal, and M1/M2 is not imposed on the competent direct route.
cases.no_learned_rule_invented: The structural admission rule and authority come from the owner's own test builders and public owner; nothing was fabricated.
cases.result: direct route proven legitimate for the same fact; structural route proven gated

hostiles.construction: A fact in state UNRESOLVED is submitted to the structural admission owner with a real named rule and ALLOW authority. The claim genuinely fails (decision_state != ADMITTED, reason_code recorded). The caller then attempts to relabel the route as DIRECT_EMPIRICAL to reach the consumer.
A SUPPORTED fact is submitted with a named rule under a DENY admission authority snapshot. The claim fails. The route is then relabelled DIRECT_EMPIRICAL.
Two envelopes over the same producer fact and reason are built, differing only in route class.
asserted: the two envelopes have different identities, so the route is part of the bound identity
neither envelope carries any authority ref
labelling a route does not change the retained analytical state
neither envelope authorizes a negative claim

identity_binding.statement: The route decision binds exact producer/result/authority identities because the route_class is inside the envelope identity preimage, alongside the exact producer refs, producer-native states and reasons.
identity_binding.consequence: Changing the route changes the envelope identity; a route cannot be edited after the fact without reidentifying the result.
